sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Core Objective**: To promote sustainability in urban areas by enhancing energy efficiency in buildings, improving solid waste management, and shifting to public transport. 
• **Institutional Nodal Agency**: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA). 
• **Strategic Focus**: Integration of climate change adaptation and mitigation into urban planning processes. 
• **Key Metric**: Reduction in per capita energy consumption and carbon footprint of urban settlements.

items.definition: A set of standards for energy-efficient design and construction of buildings, mandatory for large commercial buildings.
A collaborative effort to provide technical assistance for sustainable urban transport systems, reducing GHG emissions.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Smart Cities Mission**: Integration of ICT for efficient urban resource management. 
• **AMRUT**: Focus on water supply, sewerage, and green spaces to enhance urban resilience.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Challenges**: Rapid unplanned urbanization, lack of institutional capacity at ULB level, and high initial capital costs. 
• **Solutions**: Adoption of Green Building Rating Systems (GRIHA/LEED) and decentralized waste management.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'WET' (Waste, Energy, Transport). 
• **Decoded Meaning**: W-Waste Management, E-Energy Efficiency in Buildings, T-Transport (Public/NMT).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: The mission is NOT just about 'Green Buildings'. It is a holistic urban mission covering transport and waste as well. Do not confuse it with the 'Green India Mission'.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Urban Heat Island Effect' when discussing the need for sustainable habitats in the context of climate change mitigation.

keyTakeaways: The mission is under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA).
It focuses on the 'WET' framework: Waste, Energy, and Transport.
It acts as an umbrella policy framework for various urban missions like AMRUT and Smart Cities.
